judgment.explanation: Event-002 supports requesting that DL-007 be held until 2026-02-11 rather than returned. The proposal appropriately asks for approval instead of claiming the extension is completed, and event-001 supports contacting the Sedgeglass Counter supervisor by email. However, event-001 explicitly says the operational context is unavailable. Neither visible event establishes that an extension is permitted, that it is a two-day extension, or that the deadline should be 18:00 UTC. Those unsupported terms materially weaken an otherwise clear request. The next contact should ask whether the requested hold can be approved and clarify any applicable cutoff and return-processing arrangements without asserting unavailable policy or timing details.
